welcome: Hi! Welcome to Ankit's AI-powered portfolio. I'm the portfolio assistant — ask me about Ankit's professional journey, data-science experience, generative-AI and agentic-AI projects, skills, certifications or career opportunities. Every answer is grounded in the portfolio and links to its source.

facts.title: Availability for opportunities
facts.text: Ankit is open to full-time Data Scientist, Generative AI Engineer and Agentic AI roles, and to collaboration or freelance projects. The quickest way to reach him is the contact page or LinkedIn.

facts.title: Freelance and consulting
facts.text: For freelance or consulting work, Ankit can help with LLM applications, retrieval-augmented generation, multi-agent prototypes and machine-learning models — the same kinds of systems shown in his projects. Use the contact form and choose "Freelance / project" as the enquiry type.

facts.title: Access to private project code
facts.text: The source code for NexusAI, IntelliHub and the 2024–25 generative-AI builds is in private repositories. Ankit is happy to walk through the code or run a live demo on a call — request one from the project page or the contact page. Nine machine-learning case studies are public on GitHub.

facts.title: How this assistant works
facts.text: This assistant is a small multi-agent system built for the portfolio: an orchestrator routes each question to specialist agents (profile, technical, projects, recruitment, navigation), a hybrid keyword and embedding retriever finds evidence on this site, and a validator checks every answer against that evidence. It uses only open-source models — embeddings run in your browser, and optional answers come from an open-weight language model running on your own device. No paid AI API is used.
